facts.sub: Albergues oferecem camas baratas em quartos compartilhados, ótimas para viajantes com pouco dinheiro. Muitos também têm quartos privativos por um preço maior.

facts.label: Armários

pages.title: A bunk bed · 1/3
paragraphs: It is one in the afternoon near a beach in San Diego. Lea arrives with a big backpack and a sunburned nose. She is traveling alone for two weeks. She looks for a cheap and friendly place to sleep. A colorful hostel stands on the corner. At the desk, a young man named Kai smiles.
“Hi! Do you have any beds available for tonight?” says Lea. “Yes, we do. How many nights?” says Kai. “Three nights, please. From today until Friday.” says Lea.
